notes:
Describes cruel and oppressive governance by a ruler or government. Frequently encountered in historical and political contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暴政|ぼうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to impose tyranny
- {暴政|ぼうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧: to suffer under tyranny
- {暴政|ぼうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧: to stand up against tyranny
- {暴政|ぼうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧: to overthrow a tyranny
